corePassives.description:
Grimmjow's technique, Ultimate, and counterattack apply Destruction Mark to enemies. It can be detonated by basic attacks during the Ultimate, basic attacks chained after a technique or counterattack, granting 1 point of Spiritual Pressure Reserve. Each point of Spiritual Pressure Reserve increases Grimmjow's Basic ASPD and Strike DMG by 3%, up to 5 points. During battle, Grimmjow's Spiritual Pressure continuously drains. The more Spiritual Pressure Reserve he has, the faster it drains. When Spiritual Pressure reaches zero, 1 point of Spiritual Pressure Reserve is automatically deducted. 
 Grimmjow can use his Ultimate once his Ultimate Energy reaches 50%.
corePassives.name: Worthy Prey

corePassives.description: Using Sonido to ram into enemies allows Grimmjow to trigger Perfect Dodge manually. During Form of Destruction, after using his Ultimate, Perfect Dodge also triggers automatically whenever he is attacked. Each trigger increases Grimmjow's Strike DMG by 20% for 20 seconds.
corePassives.name: Swift and Deadly

corePassives.description: During battle, Grimmjow's Strike DMG increases by an amount equal to 15% of his Ultimate Charge Rate.
corePassives.name: Fervor

corePassives.description: When releasing his Ultimate, if Ultimate Energy is above 50%, the excess portion increases the damage of Gran Rey Cero and Enhanced Basic Attack, Form of Destruction, at a certain ratio, up to 100%. Each time Grimmjow defeats an enemy in battle, he gains Spiritual Pressure and Ultimate Energy.
corePassives.name: Impulse

skills.description:
Grimmjow launches a series of close-range attacks, dealing 4 hits for a total damage equal to 769.5% of ATK and gaining Spiritual Pressure. ~~Flash Strike~~ When Spiritual Pressure Reserve reaches 2, tap counter 
 Grimmjow leaps into the air and have Grimmjow draw his blade to slash the enemy ahead, dealing damage equal to 742.5% of ATK and gaining Spiritual Pressure. This skill consumes 2 points of Spiritual Pressure Reserve.
skills.name: Don't Disappoint Me

skills.description: Grimmjow instantly closes in on the enemy and slashes, dealing damage equal to 360% of ATK and inflicting 1 stack of Destruction Mark to enemies hit. After use, this can directly chain into the 4th hit of basic attack, immediately detonating 1 stack of Destruction Mark and granting 1 stack of Spiritual Pressure Reserve.
skills.name: Killing Intent

skills.description:
Grimmjow uses his own blood as a medium to release the strongest Gran Rey Cero, dealing damage equal to 603% of ATK to the enemy and entering Form of Destruction. During this state, basic attacks are greatly enhanced, and Ultimate Energy continuously drains. When Ultimate Energy reaches zero, Form of Destruction ends. 
 When this skill is released, immediately inflicts 5 stacks of Destruction Mark to the enemy. ~~Form of Destruction~~ During the Ultimate 
 Grimmjow draws his Zanpakuto and rapidly slashes the enemy, dealing 3 hits for a total damage equal to 774% of ATK. When this skill is released, each hit detonates 1 stack of Destruction Mark on the enemy.
skills.name: Gran Rey Cero

skills.description: Grimmjow counters the enemy's attack and fires a close-range Cero, dealing damage equal to 1350% of ATK and inflicting 2 stacks of Destruction Mark.
skills.name: Counter

skills.description: Use Sonido to avoid attacks right before they hit. Perfect Dodges inflict True Time Freeze for 1.5 seconds, during which Grimmjow gains 15% ASPD and 25% MSPD for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 15 seconds.
skills.name: Sonido
